sections.title: Get in touch
paragraphs: Questions, ideas or something that did not work? Write to rap.gardini@gmail.com. We reply within 3 business days.
For a problem, tell us what you did, what you expected and what happened, and which device you use (iPhone, Android or browser).

sections.title: Where is my data?
paragraphs: On your device. The whole app works without an account and offline. The account is optional: it syncs between devices and keeps a copy in the cloud.

sections.title: Reminders do not arrive
paragraphs: Check that notifications are allowed for Duck Habits in the device settings (in the app: Settings > Reminders > Allow notifications). A habit already done or skipped that day gets no more reminders that day. Reminders do not work in the browser.

sections.title: I forgot my password
paragraphs: In the app, go to Settings > Account and sync, type your e-mail and tap "I forgot my password". The link arrives by e-mail; check the spam folder too.

sections.title: How do I move my data to another device?
paragraphs: With an account: sign in with the same e-mail on the other device. Without one: use Settings > Backup > Export backup and, on the other device, Import backup.

sections.title: How do I delete my account?
paragraphs: In the app: Settings > Account and sync > Delete account. All the details are on the account deletion page and in the privacy policy.
